service.description: The objects of a calendar for CalDAV: each event series (not cancelled) by its name (the davName a client stored it under, else workEffortId.ics) with an entity tag over the rows that make its iCalendar text (the event, its recurrence, parties, the user's reminders and its changed instances), its time span for a time-range query, and the calendar's ctag over them all. No access check: the callers check the calendar.

The user's tasks for CalDAV's Tasks collection: the WetTask work efforts the user's party is assigned to now, not cancelled, and completed or closed ones only for 30 days after they were completed, each named by its UID (universalId, else workEffortId) with .ics, an entity tag over the task and the user's assignment, and the collection's ctag.

The CalDAV collections of the user: each calendar the user may view (not free/busy only), read only below edit permission and for a subscription, named with its owner when shared; and Tasks (collectionId tasks, VTODO). With collectionId only that one.

The objects of a collection, by name (objectNameList) or all, with their iCalendar text (withData, written as CalDAV calendar objects: no METHOD, the user's reminders as alarms); a calendar query's component (componentType) and time range (start, end in epoch millis; a recurring series is always in range).

Store an object a CalDAV client wrote: a calendar's event series (edit permission, not a subscription calendar) through store#CalendarFeedEvents by its UID, the name kept as davName; or a task in Tasks (a new one made with create#SimpleTask assigned to the user, one the user is assigned to updated: name, description, status, priority, percent complete, start, due and completion). ifMatch and ifNoneMatch are the client's preconditions; status is 412 when one fails, 403 for a calendar the user may not change, 400 for text that holds no event or to-do (or several UIDs).

A CalDAV client's delete: an event series of a calendar (edit permission) is cancelled with its changed instances, or only taken out of this calendar when it is in another; a task leaves the Tasks collection by the end of the user's assignment (the task stays for the others on it). status 412 when ifMatch fails, 404 when the name is not there, 403 when the calendar may not be changed.
